Definition: from G1722 and G5142; (figuratively) to educate:--nourish up in.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells Timothy he will be a good minister if he is nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine in 1 Timothy 4:6 — fed on them the way a child is fed, until they become his strength.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a minister is made by what he feeds on, and good doctrine is food, not decoration.
